name: focus-shell
title: Focus shell
description: A distraction-free frame for one task: a minimal header, a single centred column, a quiet footer and a clear way out.
docs: brand sits left in the header and exit (a link back or a close button) right; a ghost Button there is pulled out by its own padding so its text ends on the margin. The column is 24rem (narrow), 32rem (default) or 44rem (wide); align is center or top. footer takes the legal links and language the language switcher. The page is min-h-dvh, never a fixed 100vh: the column is centred with auto margins while there is room and starts at the top when there is not, so the page scrolls normally on a short screen or with the keyboard open. A skip link points at the one main landmark (mainId).
